name: Sport Mask
description:
FEATURES

  • Best material: Each face mask is made with 100% soft, breathable fabric. The mask can be used for more than 2 years, and the filter is recommended to be replaced every 30 days. Depending on the situation, the filter becomes black or damaged, please replace it in time.
  • Good Protection: 3D mask with N95 filter inner pocket. This reusable mouth mask covers 50% of your face with a smooth comfortable snug fit to protect your nose, mouth and lungs. This mask protects you from breathing in dust, dirt and pollen, micro-particle, droplet and smoke to guards against sinus related issues you may have. Due to the filter, our sports mask will protect you when cycling, running, or traveling. People who have had intensive skin treatments can also wear this soft cotton face mask to protect their skin from the sun and wind. Can be worn to protect against cold weather and snow.
  • Customization: We make mask on demand, so give us your design to create your one-of-a-kind mask. Creative 3D print is suited for walking, biking, hiking, jogging and others activities.
  • Gift of Love: A meaningful gift for your friends, family members, wife/husband, bridesmaid/groomsmen, coworkers on birthday, Mother's day, Father’s Day, wedding, anniversary, Christmas, engagement, Thanksgiving day, Valentine's day. A wonderful way to honor the memory of a special person or milestone by protecting you and your beloveds.
  • Garment Care: This anti dust face mask can be washed quickly either by hand or by machine. Recommend hand wash in cold water (below 30 degrees), no bleach, hang dry. This cloth mask is will remain soft, comfortable and durable after each wash and can last you for a very long time.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 3 – 5 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 7 – 15 working days average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Sport Mask

 

NOTE:

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.5-2 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 

Download templates and mockups here

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
